title: Cooking Together ABC
hook: Right task, right hands, one kitchen team.
roundStructure: Round 1 lexical-semantic A-Z; Round 2 retrieval-action A-Z; 4+4+4+4+4+4+2 chunks
visualStyle: cozy 3D preschool family-kitchen storybook, warm colors, safe supervised cooking cues, uncluttered foregrounds

creativeFingerprint.pointOfView: a child helping an adult cook safely
creativeFingerprint.round2Grammar: role cue -> recall beat -> target -> pretend pass/point gesture
creativeFingerprint.sectionContrast: Round 1 paints clues; chorus opens wide; Round 2 strips back for recall. Signature: a warm guitar pluck plus soft hand-clap confirmation after the target.
creativeFingerprint.signatureColor: a warm guitar pluck plus soft hand-clap confirmation after the target
creativeFingerprint.authorialIntent: Make Cooking Together ABC a collaboration protocol: children can wash, count, pour cool ingredients or set napkins when age-appropriate; adults own knives, heat and powered appliances.
creativeFingerprint.lyricIdentity: A child and adult pass tasks by capability and hazard, emphasizing consent, hygiene and age-appropriate help.
